assessment_objectives.objective: a current inventory of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) with Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) exposure is maintained.
the inventory includes public key algorithms vulnerable to Cryptographically Relevant Quantum Computers (CRQCs).
the inventory includes long-lived keys and certificates (e.g., CA roots, firmware signing keys, etc.).
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: a validity period or key lifetime of more than 1 year

assessment_objectives.objective: the inventory includes TAAS that cannot easily adopt PQC upgrades (e.g., embedded, RTOS, etc.).
